recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, minimalist portrait of a male artist positioned off-center, featuring a stark white background, warm-toned clothing, and heavy gold accessories, paired with gritty, textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, looking downward to create a sense of introspection.
Contrast between the clean, blown-out white background and the detailed texture of the clothing and jewelry.
Typography anchored on the left, balancing the visual weight of the subject.
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal shadows on the background.
Warm color palette for the subject (gold, beige, tan) against a neutral white.
Distressed or grimy texture applied specifically to the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right 60% of the frame, cropped from the waist up, leaning slightly into the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses, followed by the large textured title text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the downward gaze to the jewelry, then moves left to the primary text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left and top-left provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-contrast isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair and text shadows for definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and tan for the suit and jewelry, providing warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout, with saturation concentrated in the gold tones.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant cool colors like blue or green.
Limit the palette to white, black, and warm earth/metallic tones.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary title features a heavy 'grunge' or 'concrete' texture overlay.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured display font paired with a light, clean geometric sans-serif for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Faint, large-scale ghosted lettering in the background for depth.
Small cross or plus-sign icons as decorative accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric presence for the main title.
Offers a clean, modern contrast for the secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-key studio portrait of a man with dreadlocks wearing a tan linen suit jacket, white t-shirt, and multiple heavy gold chains. He is looking down. The background is pure, blown-out white with a very faint, large-scale watermark of abstract letters in light gray.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy black sans-serif font with a distressed concrete texture. Below it, add a subtitle in a thin, gold-colored sans-serif font with wide letter spacing. Place a small black and white advisory label in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text heavily textured?
Is the subject looking down and positioned to the right?
Is the subtitle color-matched to the jacket or jewelry?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the grunge texture on the text
Opacity of the background ghosted lettering
Warmth of the gold/tan color grade
mustRedesign: Exact brand logos or advisory stickers

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the subject's clothing texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the texture.
Verify the subject's skin tones remain natural under high-key lighting.
Check that the gold jewelry has a metallic sheen.
Confirm the composition feels balanced between the subject and the negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Off-center subject + Textured heavy sans-serif + Clean light sans-serif subtitle + Warm metallic accents.
